description: This source file contains implementation of Orleans streaming grains, including producer and consumer grains, as well as observer classes for handling stream events. It appears to be part of a test suite, providing sample streaming grains for unit testing scenarios.

classes.name: SampleConsumerObserver`1
classes.description: An asynchronous observer implementation that processes stream items, logs events, and updates the hosting grain's item count.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A grain that produces stream items periodically, manages stream connection, and tracks the number of items produced.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that consumes stream items, manages subscription, and tracks the number of items consumed.

classes.name: SampleStreaming_InlineConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that subscribes to a stream with inline handlers for stream events, manages subscription lifecycle, and counts received items.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items for the observer.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream producer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts a timer to periodically produce stream items.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Returns the count of items produced.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Triggers a produce action (fires a stream item).

methods.name: TimerCallback
methods.description: Callback triggered by timer to produce stream items.

methods.name: Fire
methods.description: Sends the current item to the stream and increments the count.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream consumer and subscribes to a stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the count of items consumed.
